owner_correction: Use Pangram in the humanization-learning flow when the supervisor genuinely expects the candidate to pass. Pangram can serve as a check on mistaken model judgments that prose looks human. Do not let a detector miss trigger another open-ended experimental loop or drift into adjacent work.

pangram_role.admission: Run Pangram only on an exact frozen candidate that has passed architecture review and preservation/reverse-traceability, and that the supervisor predicts should be Human.
pangram_role.interpretation: A Pangram AI/Mixed result proves the supervisor's human-likeness prediction failed at that exact boundary; diagnose the literal prose independently rather than treating detector windows as causal explanations.

anti_drift_budget.on_first_detector_failure: One bounded diagnosis and one materially changed generation-method attempt are allowed.
anti_drift_budget.after_second_detector_result_or_second_m: Mandatory owner checkpoint. Do not open a new experiment family, run factorial/minimal-pair searches, hunt phrases, continue article completion, or consume another paid call without new owner direction.

progress_rule: Count a negative result as STRATEGY_LEARNING only when it eliminates or narrows a live method hypothesis. Activity volume is not progress.
